knowledge.name: Synthetic regulatory report portfolio
knowledge.detail: Fixed EPA, FERC, PHMSA, and state report records include facility, period, deadline, status, owner, completeness, and quality.

knowledge.name: Validation rules and source mappings
knowledge.detail: Bundled rules map emissions, financial, and safety checks to synthetic systems such as CEMS, SAP, PIMS, and GIS.

knowledge.name: Audit finding evidence
knowledge.detail: Fixed findings link report IDs to evidence gaps, severity, remediation state, and due dates for deterministic review.

knowledge.name: Reporting controls and operating rules
knowledge.detail: Uploaded instructions define operation routing, required evidence anchors, authorized reviewers, and filing prohibitions.

intelligence_processing.name: Report portfolio status analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Sorts the selected portfolio by deadline and summarizes submitted, overdue, in-progress, and not-started records.

intelligence_processing.name: Source-data quality screening
intelligence_processing.detail: Checks completeness and quality thresholds, calculates a pass rate, and identifies exceptions before owner attestation.

intelligence_processing.name: Recorded submission-state tracking
intelligence_processing.detail: Presents authority, owner, deadline, status, and last update as read-only evidence without transmitting a filing.

intelligence_processing.name: Audit-readiness triage
intelligence_processing.detail: Groups findings by report and counts open and high-severity items without predicting an audit or legal outcome.

intelligence_processing.name: Scoped report filtering
intelligence_processing.detail: Limits analysis to a requested synthetic report ID and returns no substituted record when the identifier is unknown.

intelligence_processing.name: Evidence-first response assembly
intelligence_processing.detail: Formats traceable tables and explicit limitations so reviewers can separate recorded evidence from future actions.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat and API
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file RAPP tool through local chat and streaming endpoints with bundled synthetic evidence.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides four natural-language operation skills and two uploaded knowledge files in an unpublished Draft agent.

clients_user_interface.name: Persona-guided review flows
clients_user_interface.detail: Supports Regulatory Reporting Lead, Data Analyst, Compliance Manager, and Internal Auditor evidence-review scenarios.

management_reporting.name: Regulatory Report Status
management_reporting.detail: Reports portfolio totals, authorities, facilities, owners, deadlines, status, completeness, and data-quality scores.

management_reporting.name: Data Validation Results
management_reporting.detail: Reports pass rate, quality scores, completeness, threshold exceptions, and the need for authorized owner attestation.

management_reporting.name: Submission Tracker
management_reporting.detail: Reports recorded filing state and last-update evidence while stating that no filing, signature, or transmission occurred.

management_reporting.name: Audit Readiness Assessment
management_reporting.detail: Reports finding counts, severity, status, due dates, and source discrepancies for remediation review.

tools.name: RegulatoryReportingAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Portable Python BasicAgent exposes four deterministic, read-only operations over bundled synthetic records.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the tool and provides chat, streaming, health, and model-selection endpoints.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The deployment environment supplies the model for request interpretation and grounded response presentation.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the Draft conversational agent, operation skills, and knowledge files; publication requires confirmation.

tools.name: Synthetic knowledge and skill files
tools.detail: Two knowledge files and four operation skills preserve the same evidence, routing, and safety controls.

tools.name: Documented production connection seams
tools.detail: A regulatory data lake, controlled workspace, and approved filing connector are future seams, not configured tools.

supporting_features.name: Fixed four-operation routing
supporting_features.detail: An explicit enum dispatches report status, data validation, submission tracking, or audit-readiness review.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only fail-closed evidence
supporting_features.detail: The package uses fixed fictional records, does not browse for replacements, and does not invent unknown identifiers.

supporting_features.name: Audit-ready evidence traceability
supporting_features.detail: Report IDs, owners, deadlines, quality measures, source-system references, findings, severity, and due dates stay visible.

supporting_features.name: Authorized human approval gates
supporting_features.detail: Report owners must resolve and attest evidence; any future write requires authentication, authorization, approval, and an audit event.

supporting_features.name: No automatic filing boundary
supporting_features.detail: The agent never signs, certifies, files, publishes, or transmits a report and never treats a model response as proof of action.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and draft control
supporting_features.detail: Four persona cases passed strict isolation and Copilot Studio preview while both validated agents remained unpublished.
